description: Agent Claims: submit an adjuster’s report with the inspection record and the claim file: the report with its reference, the claim number it cites, the inspection day it states, each damage finding with its id, the item, the damage found and the cause given, the currency, each valuation line with its id, item, quantity, unit price and amount, the stated total, the depreciation, the deductible and the valuation; the inspection record with the claim number it cites, the day of the inspection and each item inspected with its id, the item, the damage recorded and whether it was placed in the repair scope; and optionally the claim file with its claim number, day of loss and cause of loss. The signed report gives the report, the inspection and the claim, each finding paired with the item inspected and its damage read against the damage recorded, every finding on an item never inspected, each scoped item carried into the report as a finding or a valuation line and every one dropped, and the valuation recomputed from its lines, total, depreciation and deductible, and counts them, and names a divergent report: a damage finding unlike the inspection, a finding on an item the inspection never recorded, a scoped item dropped between inspection and report, and a valuation that does not recompute from its own line items; then another claim number, another inspection day and a cause unlike the claim file, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A report with no findings, an inspection with no items, or no valuation lines, total or valuation leaves the report unverified. Items and damage read by their words with plurals folded, and the arithmetic compares to the cent. This reads the report against the inspection and the claim file as recorded. Verdict claims_adjuster_report_divergent, claims_adjuster_report_partial, claims_adjuster_report_unverified or claims_adjuster_report_consistent. POST /api/claims-adjuster-report-check. Reads the claim records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between claim documents only: it never files or submits a claim, never negotiates or pays one and never decides coverage, which stays with the insurer, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Claims reads claim records across the claim lifecycle for consistency between the claim documents and the policy they claim under: a first notice of loss, a sworn proof of loss, an adjuster’s report, a repair or replacement estimate, a settlement offer and release, a denial letter, a subrogation demand and a claim payment record, each against the policy, the first notice, the inspection record and claim file, the approved scope, the claim valuation, the claim record, the payment record or the settlement or adjudication it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral across property, casualty and liability claims and reads different claim documents against each other and against the policy. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-claims-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-claims/.

loss_date.description: The day of loss, such as 2026-10-15.

peril.description: The cause of loss on file.

ref.description: The claim number of the claim file, such as CLM-2026-0412.

claim_ref.description: The claim number the inspection cites, such as CLM-2026-0412.

scoped.description: In the repair scope; every item when left out.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

claim_ref.description: The claim number the report cites, such as CLM-2026-0412.

damage.description: The damage found, such as hail bruising or no damage.

item.description: The item or area, such as roof covering.

inspected_on.description: The inspection day the report states, such as 2026-10-15.

total.description: The stated total of the lines.

valuation.description: The valuation after depreciation and deductible.
